reviews.text:
Sea Blue Pool did an excellent job replastering my pool, and their two-month chemical treatment afterward was just as impressive. The crew worked efficiently, kept the site clean, and explained each stage of the process so I always knew what to expect. The plaster finish is smooth, uniform, and clearly high quality.

What really stood out was their knowledge, ability to communicate complex details easily and their follow-up care: their technicians monitored the water balance closely, made precise adjustments, and explained why each chemical step mattered for curing the new surface. The result was a trouble-free startup and crystal-clear water from day one.

Overall, Sea Blue Pool delivered professional workmanship, reliable communication, and measurable results.  In addition, their impressive show room in Blue Mound (Fort Worth) had an abundance of tile choices, along with deck painting ideas.   Highly recommend them if you want a replaster job done right with a reasonable price and expert post-treatment support.
reviews.author: M Caulfield

reviews.text: I am extremely impressed with the service I received. My pool pump was ancient and decided to completely stop, our whole pool turned green over night. JC was able to get out to us quickly  to assess the issue and give us a quote. He came out the very next day to replace our pump, pour a concrete pad for us and treat the pool to get it back to where it needed to be. He was professional, knowledgeable, fair with pricing and friendly throughout the entire process. I am beyond satisfied with the quality of work and the level of customer service provided. I highly recommend this pool company to anyone in need of pool maintenance or repairs. Thank you for a job well done!
reviews.author: Trenae Marsh

reviews.text: We needed some mortar repair around the retaining of wall of our pool. Our request was pretty last minute, but Sea Blue was quick to respond and worked hard to get us in to their busy schedule last minute. The technician was skilled, friendly, and helpful. Our pool was originally built by pool quest, but it was impossible to get them to return our calls. 10/10 recommended Sea Blue Pools.
reviews.author: Heather christiansen

reviews.text: We hired JC and his crew this summer to do a complete remodel on our old 80s pool. An appointment to give us a quote was scheduled quickly. He walked us through the entire process and we went to his showroom to see his products. We upgraded to pebble plaster and added a sundeck at an amazing price. He stayed in constant contact with us during the entire construction process making frequents on site visits and even doing the equipment exchange and upgrade himself. His crew was courteous and did a phenomenal job. After it was all done, JC sent a cleaning crew in to clean everything, even the windows. I can’t recommend Sea Blue Pool enough. The entire process was seamless and the best experience we have ever had with a contractor.
reviews.author: Joann Wallace

reviews.text: We use Sea Blue Pools for weekly pool service since 2021 and not a single complaint. They are very reliable and I never have to worry about my pool! They will notice if a part is needed and let me know - it’s never something exorbitant and it’s never often, but nice to not have to worry about potential problems as they are catching them as they come. Thank you guys for making pool ownership carefree!
reviews.author: Alex Williams

Our overall experience with Sea Blue Pools has been excellent!  We had a 22 year old pool that had served us well, but we were needing an overall re-do.  I had several companies bid the job, but JC won our business hands down by returning calls promptly, showing up when he said he would, having an excellent show room and giving us a fair price.  We weren't disappointed -- our refinished pool is beautiful!    We originally had a hot tub and we requested that it be removed during the remodel, although we kept the bench and the entry stairs.  Our whole pool looks and feels so much larger now, and we will get so much more use out of that area (without the added cost of the gas bills heating it!)
I can't say enough about the excellent communication this company offers!  JC and Miriam are amazing at letting you know schedules, processes -- you get pictures of what has been done on any given day-- it's awesome!  The workers are diligent and skilled--shoutout to Eugene who is amazing.  Work is done when its scheduled, cleaned up properly, and they included two months of pool service to make sure everything gets off to a great start!  JC has been in contact with us throughout the process --even installed our new pump himself.  Their customer service has been excellent!
reviews.author: KG

reviews.text: We’ve had Sea Blue Pools provide weekly pool service for several years, very dependable and  always have our pool looking great. After 12 years, our pool needed a remodel and pool equipment replaced. I shopped a few pool companies for quotes and we decided to go with Sea Blue Pools.  The whole experience went great, JC kept us updated daily on the process and what to expect next. I highly recommend Sea Blue Pools for any weekly service or pool remodel.  5 stars!!
reviews.author: Matt Hunt

reviews.text:
A friend of mine recommended Sea Blue Pools when my former pool service company had let my pool turn green and I said I was look for a new company.

JC quickly came out to assess the situation and has scheduled technicians to come out every couple of days to treat pool and monitor progress.

Given the state of the pool when they took over, I've been very impressed with their service,  communication and knowledge of pools.  We have just a little ways to go to get too 100%, but highly recommend Sea Blue Pools.
reviews.author: Donna A
